Body.Content:
New updates to Azure Cost Management help you better understand what you're spending, where, and how to plan for the future.

These updates enable you to:

  • Reconcile invoiced charges with the new invoice details view.
  • Automate reporting across subscriptions with management group exports.
  • Get alerts for Cost Management Labs updates and share feedback.
  • Save and share customized views in the cost analysis feature.
  • Download charts to share views outside the Azure portal.
  • Find new ways to save money with Azure.
  • Get alerts for Azure Cost Management documentation updates.

Read more about Azure Cost Management updates.
